top_signals.title: Houthi Attacks Intensify Threat of Wider War in Middle East
top_signals.summary: Col. Wayne Sanders (Ret.) of Bloomberg Intelligence examines whether continued attacks in Saudi Arabia by Yemen’s Houthis could draw the United States into defending the kingdom. He speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Russia clears Sberbank for crypto trading ahead of December launch
top_signals.summary: Russia’s largest bank, Sberbank, has secured crypto exchange authorization as it prepares to offer Bitcoin, Ether and Tether USDt trading.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: LSEG in Talks to Buy Permira-Owned Credit Firm Octus
top_signals.summary: London Stock Exchange Group Plc is in talks over a potential acquisition of global credit platform Octus from private equity firm Permira, people familiar with the matter said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: DGB Offers Ethan Allen CEO a Non-Board Advisory Role
top_signals.summary: DGB Investments has offered an olive branch of sorts to the head of Ethan Allen Interiors Inc. as the activist seeks to replace the furniture company’s board and chief executive officer.

top_signals.title: IonQ to acquire cybersecurity firm Elisity in an all-stock deal for up to $1.3 billion
top_signals.summary: Quantum computing platform is buying cybersecurity firm Elisity in an all-stock deal for up to $1.3 billion.

top_signals.title: Pakistan Faces $1 Billion LNG Bill This Winter
top_signals.summary: Pakistan will have to pay in excess of $1 billion to secure LNG supply for the winter months, as spot prices soar amid massive disruptions to Qatari term supply. The price tag will be fueled by the spot LNG prices in Asia surging to three-year highs and the plans of the Pakistani government to import 10 LNG cargoes from the spot market, at double the price at which LNG is being imported from Qatar, local daily Tribune reported on Tuesday. Amid disrupted supplies from Qatar, Pakistan will have to purchase these additional 10 cargoes on the spot…
